# Safe generated files

Preview the exact relative paths and hashes before writing. Create with private permissions when a
file can reveal project structure. Refuse symlink destinations, parent traversal, existing paths,
and writes outside the selected root. A partial failure must remove only files created by that run.

Generate minimal `.rehearseignore`, recipe, skill, and brain configuration from templates. Use
synthetic placeholders and comments for every project-specific backup, image, or check value.
